rca of the issue: Resolved: Original 404 root cause was FastAPI's default str path-converter matching only one URL segment, while uvicorn decodes %2F before route matching, causing child ids containing '/' to never match. Fix applied (one-character change per route: `{child_srn_no}` → `{child_srn_no:path}` x2 and `{child_ern_no}` → `{child_ern_no:path}` x2). Re-run confirms all PUT/DELETE child endpoints now reachable; status recompute, RKN-edit-block, and parent items[] mutation all behave correctly.
